newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: PCL unit sells vessel for US$11.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: PCL unit sells vessel for US$11.2 mln.

text.p: Pacific Carriers Ltd (PCL) said on Wednesday its subsidiary, Ikan Bilis Shipping (Singapore) Pte Ltd, had agreed to sell a vessel at US$11.2 million.
The vessel, m.v. Ikan Bilis, would be sold to Silver Yang Navigation Inc, a company statement said.
The transaction would not have any material effect on PCL's earning per share and net tangible assets per share, it added.
PCL's share ended unchanged at Singapore $1.03 on Wednesday.
